create_random_erasing: create a RandomErasing augmentation instance with configurable probability, area, and mode for image data augmentation
apply_random_erasing_single: apply random erasing to a single 3-channel image tensor by calling the RandomErasing instance on it
apply_random_erasing_batch: apply random erasing to a batch of image tensors using the cube mode for efficient batch-wide erasure
configure_erase_mode: configure the RandomErasing class with const, rand, or pixel erase mode for different pixel filling strategies
build_random_erasing_pipeline: build a random erasing data augmentation pipeline with adjustable aspect ratio, area range, and per-image block count
